records.time_basis: 18:49 Pacific in APP; converted to Eastern daylight time.
records.title: Healer imagery with glowing hands
records.media_description: A robed central figure heals a reclining man amid prayer, radiating light and national-military symbols.
records.description_basis: News reproduction visually inspected; source text attributes the depicted central subject and publishing account to Trump.
records.provenance_status: Earlier related version located; original artist, modification author and direct transfer route not established.
records.version_note: The reproduced versions differ in a background figure. This is a version distinction, not proof of who altered it or what that person intended.
records.followup: APP records removal. Later reporting records Trump's explanation that he thought it represented him as a doctor. Neither the later explanation nor removal erases the publication event.
records.interpretive_relevance: Within the wiki's reading, the important correspondence is the presentation of political leadership through extraordinary healing authority. Distribution by the subject's own account makes this more directly relevant than an unaffiliated fan image. The source establishes a representation, not a performed miracle.

records.time_basis: Explicit Eastern time in individual archive; agrees with APP's 05:34 Pacific.
records.title: Religious endorsement shared from an X account
records.media_description: A screenshot combines a religious embrace illustration, an American flag and a caption presenting Trump as an instrument of God.
records.description_basis: Archived screenshot visually inspected; its account name is read from the artifact, not inferred from a face.
records.caption_excerpt_from_upstream: God might be playing his Trump card!
records.caption_excerpt_from_trump: I think it is quite nice
records.provenance_status: Upstream handle and screenshot republication documented; original artwork creator and canonical upstream X URL remain unknown.
records.interpretive_relevance: This is a particularly useful promotion-chain example: an outside account supplies religious legitimization and the political subject republishes it approvingly. The relational comparison concerns who promotes whose authority; it does not require Trump to have originated the image or every word of its caption.

records.time_basis: 19:29 Pacific in APP; converted to Eastern daylight time.
records.title: Papal representation and official amplification
records.media_description: A papal portrait places the subject in white vestments and headdress on an ornate chair with a raised forefinger.
records.description_basis: APP label and contemporary reporting; no direct visual inspection of the primary attachment in this session.
records.followup: Trump later denied personal involvement in producing or posting it. The narrower documented claim is publication by his account and subsequent amplification by the White House account.
records.interpretive_relevance: The image assigns the visual authority of a religious office to a political leader. For the wiki's contemporary mapping, the interpretive subject is that fusion and its distribution through political channels, not an assertion that he actually held the depicted office.

records.time_basis: Explicit Eastern time in the individual archive, matching 14:16 Pacific in APP.
records.title: Red-button command and nuclear imagery
records.media_description: A command-room illustration shows a finger on a red button, a mushroom-cloud display and a Space Force heading.
records.description_basis: Archived attachment visually inspected. The archive identifies the account publication; no face identification is used as provenance.
records.version_note: A nearby command-image publication is linked separately. Exact identity between versions has not been established by hashes.
records.interpretive_relevance: The visual places destructive capability under one person's immediate control. That is directly relevant to the user's question about a ruler represented as militarily overwhelming. A fictional depiction of nuclear-scale destruction is not evidence of an actual launch order.

circulation_relationships.qualification: Earlier publication is documented; the original artist, editing history and exact route to Trump's account are not.
The screenshot visibly carries the upstream handle; this establishes republication of that screenshot, not native repost metadata or original artwork authorship.
Contemporary reporting documents the official-account repost. The exact native timestamp was not recovered and this is not counted as a post by @realDonaldTrump on X.
